# MkdirRaceCondition

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `MkdirRaceConditionInspection`

`mkdir()` fails when the directory already exists — including when another
process created it a moment after our own `is_dir()` check. A failed
`mkdir()` must therefore be followed by an `is_dir()` re-check before being
treated as an error, and its result must not be ignored.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{3,7,8,9,10,11} [Before]
<?php
function prepare($root, $cfg) {
    @mkdir($root, 0750);
    $made = mkdir("$root/cache");
    mkdir($root . '/tmp') or exit(1);

    if ((false === mkdir($root))) {}
    if ((mkdir("$root/log", 0700, true))) {}
    if ((mkdir(dirname($root)))) {}
    if (file_exists($root) || mkdir($root, permissions: 0700)) {}
    if ($cfg->ok && !mkdir(strtolower($root))) {}

    if (!is_dir($root) && !mkdir($root) && !is_dir($root)) {}
    return mkdir($root);
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function prepare($root, $cfg) {
    if (!mkdir($root, 0750) && !is_dir($root)) { throw new \RuntimeException(sprintf('Directory "%s" was not created', $root)); }
    $made = mkdir("$root/cache");
    mkdir($root . '/tmp') or exit(1);

    if (!mkdir($root) && !is_dir($root)) {}
    if (mkdir("$root/log", 0700, true) || is_dir("$root/log")) {}
    if (mkdir($concurrentDirectory = dirname($root)) || is_dir($concurrentDirectory)) {}
    if (file_exists($root) || mkdir($root, permissions: 0700) || is_dir($root)) {}
    if ($cfg->ok && !mkdir($concurrentDirectory = strtolower($root)) && !is_dir($concurrentDirectory)) {}

    if (!is_dir($root) && !mkdir($root) && !is_dir($root)) {}
    return mkdir($root);
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: mkdir() outcome is ignored; use &#39;if (!mkdir($root, 0750) &amp;&amp; !is_dir(...)) &#123; ... &#125;&#39;.</li>
<li>line 7: Re-check with is_dir() after a failed mkdir: &#39;!mkdir($root) &amp;&amp; !is_dir(...)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 8: Re-check with is_dir() after a failed mkdir: &#39;mkdir(&#34;$root/log&#34;, 0700, true) || is_dir(...)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 9: Re-check with is_dir() after a failed mkdir: &#39;mkdir(dirname($root)) || is_dir(...)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 10: Re-check with is_dir() after a failed mkdir: &#39;mkdir($root, permissions: 0700) || is_dir(...)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 11: Re-check with is_dir() after a failed mkdir: &#39;!mkdir(strtolower($root)) &amp;&amp; !is_dir(...)&#39;.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "MkdirRaceCondition": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore MkdirRaceCondition

/**
 * @noinspection MkdirRaceConditionInspection
 */
```
